goal: Installable, production-wired Runtime v1 proven through the real Housefold HA App repository on disposable HAOS. No self-waivers.

tasks.title: Reconcile productization contract and production composition
acceptance: Audit cmd/runtime and all completed harness libraries against PRODUCTIZATION.md; map every production wiring gap and remove obsolete harness contradictions.
Update runtime spec/ADRs only where accepted productization decisions extend them; preserve prior evidence as history.
Define production composition/startup/recovery ownership so BIOS/control plane can survive degraded subsystems.

tasks.title: Ship normal HA App packaging and zero-config startup
acceptance: Make Runtime installable as a normal Housefold HAOS App for amd64/aarch64 with start-on-boot, watchdog and ingress conventions.
No mandatory first-run HA URL/token/config; use Supervisor/HA environment and native HA APIs.
Use normal HA App update/config/backup/log lifecycle; watchdog represents Runtime only, not HA/Bridge/module readiness.

tasks.title: Implement admin-only BIOS management and recovery plane
acceptance: Serve the lightweight BIOS-style UI through HA ingress and enforce HA-admin authorization server-side; deny non-admins.
Provide full Runtime/module lifecycle, diagnostics, storage, Bridge, rollback/quarantine and recovery management required by PRODUCTIZATION.md.
BIOS remains available in degraded/recovery-required Runtime states whenever HA ingress itself is available; no standalone LAN admin endpoint.

tasks.title: Wire production module supervisor and storage
acceptance: Compose existing IPC/state/timeline/execution/launcher/cutover/handover/retention/quarantine mechanisms into the production Runtime process.
Persist desired module state; restore enabled modules after Runtime recovery, preserve disabled/quarantined state, honor required/optional dependencies transactionally.
Standardize module health/readiness/UI-health separation and Runtime-owned persistent/cache/generation/temp storage with quotas and safe reset/removal semantics.

tasks.title: Implement Supervisor-like official module catalog lifecycle
acceptance: Implement one remotely maintained signed official Housefold catalog with verified cached metadata and no custom/unsigned repositories.
Implement production download/stage/verify/install/update/remove flows, dependency planning and familiar HA-App-like lifecycle UX through BIOS.
Interrupted/offline catalog operations cannot affect active modules; removal preserves data by default; updates use ready-before-cutover/drain/retention.

tasks.title: Wire production HA actions, discovery and operational signals
acceptance: Connect the fenced action gateway to the production local HA transport without blind retry of unknown outcomes and with module/generation/execution attribution.
Implement native discovery collection feeding canonical discovery/bindings while preserving generic unknown access and stable identities where HA supplies them.
Expose bounded stable Runtime/module diagnostic entities/events to HA for native automations plus actionable persistent notifications; no HA admin controls.

tasks.title: Integrate logs, diagnostics and administrative audit
acceptance: Route Runtime and bounded structured module logs into the native HA App live log stream with module/version/generation attribution.
Provide structured BIOS diagnostics and privacy-safe downloadable diagnostics excluding secrets/household state by default.
Persist a bounded administrative audit trail with HA-admin identity when reliably available.

tasks.title: Implement resource, pressure and storage policy
acceptance: Support module resource requests/limits, Runtime safety ceilings, visible usage and priority classes; sustained violations use normal restart/quarantine semantics.
Under host pressure protect Runtime first and evict/recover only Housefold modules in controlled priority order; never manage HA Core/unrelated Apps.
Implement bounded storage accounting and safe GC ordering; protect active/retained durable state and fail closed for write-requiring operations when safe space is exhausted.

tasks.title: Complete backup, restore, reset and reboot recovery
acceptance: Make HA App backup/restore capture a consistent recoverable Runtime + managed-module estate using normal HA mechanisms.
Implement conservative Runtime/HAOS restart recovery before new module work, bounded schedule replay and preserved unknown actions.
Implement explicit factory reset to fresh-install state plus targeted non-nuclear reset/cleanup operations; never silently reset durable state.

tasks.title: Complete optional Bridge production integration
acceptance: Expose absent/incompatible/available/active Bridge status and user guidance; installation remains user-controlled through normal HA mechanisms.
Automatically negotiate compatible enrichment without Runtime restart and preserve native fallback.

Do not activate production ordered-state Bridge selection without version-pinned Python barrier/sequence compatibility evidence; if absent, native state remains production path and this limitation is explicit.

tasks.title: Build real Housefold distribution infrastructure
acceptance: Choose sensible repo boundaries and, where GitHub permission permits, create/wire the Housefold HA App repository and signed module catalog hosting (GitHub Pages is an acceptable default).
Create CI/release automation for exact amd64/aarch64 artifacts, catalog metadata/signatures and installable repository metadata without embedding secrets.
Prove release artifacts are reproducible/traceable to source and that Runtime/module releases remain loosely coupled by declared compatibility.

tasks.title: Run independent adversarial security gate
acceptance: Perform an independent review of ingress admin enforcement, module identity, credential/FD inheritance, catalog/signature/package verification, traversal/symlink/archive/resource attacks, IPC/log flooding, stale authority/actions, rollback, backup tampering and recovery corruption.
Add adversarial tests/fixtures and fix all high-severity findings before completion.
Record reviewer independence/method, exact findings, fixes, residual risks and verification.

tasks.title: Run bounded performance and resilience soak
acceptance: On representative disposable supported infrastructure exercise prolonged operation, repeated HA loss/recovery, module crash/quarantine, repeated upgrades/cutovers, state/event/log load, CPU/memory/disk pressure and Runtime restart.
Measure memory/CPU/disk, goroutines/threads, FDs, shutdown/recovery and trend growth; establish justified release thresholds.
Unexplained monotonic leaks or unsafe resource growth block completion.

tasks.title: Pass exact-artifact disposable HAOS acceptance
acceptance: Install the exact candidate through the actual Housefold HA App repository on clean supported disposable HAOS, not by sideloading the image.

Exercise install/start/start-on-boot/watchdog/BIOS/admin denial/native HA; install a synthetic/reference catalog module; lifecycle/logging; HA restart; Runtime restart; module update/cutover; backup/restore; uninstall/reinstall; dependency/resource/storage/failure recovery.
Record exact HAOS/Core/Supervisor versions and architecture. Docker/mocks/library tests do not substitute. Any unavailable criterion remains blocked and prevents v1 completion.

tasks.title: Publish validated v1 candidate and close productization harness
acceptance: Publish the exact artifact/repository/catalog proven by V1P14 using the configured distribution pipeline; do not rebuild a materially different artifact after acceptance.
Update Runtime spec, README, install/recovery documentation, STATE/HANDOFF and release evidence to describe only proven support.
python3 scripts/agent_tasks.py next reports no ready/active/blocked task and no release criterion has been waived; live HAOS remains untouched.
